title: Large language model-based biological age prediction in large-scale populations

evidence_spans.quote: Here we propose a framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) to estimate individual overall and organ-specific aging
six population-based cohorts, encompassing over 10 million participants
LLM-based aging assessment framework offers a precise, reliable and cost-effective approach for estimating overall and organ-specific aging
applied age gaps to identify proteomic biomarkers associated with accelerated aging

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This original analysis studies biological aging in population cohorts. It reports proteomic biomarkers alongside health-report-based prediction, but does not state a completed multi-omics or integrated-omics analysis or clearly analyze two molecular modalities.

causal_design_reviewer.comparator: Other aging proxies, including telomere length, frailty index, epigenetic ages, and machine-learning models
causal_design_reviewer.estimand_or_contrast: C-index and hazard ratio for all-cause mortality

evidence_spans.quote: Our results showed that the LLM-predicted overall age achieved a concordance index
to develop risk prediction models of 270 diseases

causal_design_reviewer.concise_rationale: The report presents completed analyses of cohort data, but describes prediction and associations rather than an applied qualifying causal or intervention design.

directional_result_reviewer.concise_rationale: The abstract reports predictive performance and associations, but no completed current-report directional X-to-Y result matching the specified criteria.
